# terraform-github-bootstrap

> Bootstrap the nolte GitHub org via Terraform: org settings, teams, branch protection rulesets.

<!-- Badges will be regenerated by `project-structure-apply` once workflows have run on the default branch. -->

## Purpose

This repository owns the **organisation-level** GitHub configuration for [`nolte`](https://github.com/nolte) as code, using the [`integrations/github`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/integrations/github/latest/docs) Terraform provider.

It is a deliberate complement to [`nolte/gh-plumbing`](https://github.com/nolte/gh-plumbing):

| Concern | Source of truth |
|---|---|
| Organisation settings (member permissions, 2FA, default-repo-permissions) | **this repo** (Terraform) |
| Teams and team memberships | **this repo** (Terraform) |
| Branch protection / repository rulesets at the org level | **this repo** (Terraform) |
| Per-repo settings, labels, merge-strategy, branch-protection per repo | [`gh-plumbing`](https://github.com/nolte/gh-plumbing) (Probot Settings App via `_extends`) |
| Reusable workflows, Boring-Cyborg / Stale / Release-Drafter commons | [`gh-plumbing`](https://github.com/nolte/gh-plumbing) |

## Getting started

```sh
# Install pinned tool versions via asdf / mise (see .tool-versions when added).
task -l                 # discover available targets
task tf:fmt             # format
task tf:validate        # validate
task tf:plan            # plan against the live org (requires GITHUB_TOKEN)
task tf:apply           # apply (requires GITHUB_TOKEN with admin:org scope)
```

State backend is currently **local** (`terraform.tfstate` next to the module). When a remote backend is adopted, update `terraform/backend.tf` and migrate state explicitly.

## Structure

```
terraform/
  org/                  # nolte organisation: settings, teams, rulesets
docs/                   # MkDocs source (English)
.github/                # Probot configs + reusable-workflow consumers
```

> **Spec note.** `spec/project/project-structure/` does not currently list `terraform/` as a sanctioned top-level source tree (only `src/`, `custom_components/`, `.claude-plugin/`, `playbooks/`+`roles/`). This repository uses `terraform/` as a conscious extension — analogous to the Ansible exception. Tracked under `spec/source-layout-extension.md` once the spec amendment lands upstream.
